name: Northeast Couloir
approach: From the Stuart Lake/Mountaineer Creek trailhead, follow the trail toward the Colchuck Lake junction, then leave the trail to bushwhack and cross Mountaineer Creek (a notorious slide-alder slope is best avoided via nearby talus). Snow is typically encountered around 4,700 ft; continue to the base of the north face couloir.

waypoints.name: Stuart Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From US-2 at the western edge of Leavenworth, turn onto Icicle Creek Road and drive 8.4 miles, then turn left onto Eightmile Road (FS Road 7601) and follow the rough dirt road 3.7 miles to the Stuart Lake Trailhead at about 3,400 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park and day trips need the free self-issued Enchantment day-use permit; the road is usually gated November into May.

waypoints.name: Argonaut Peak Summit
waypoints.directions: Follow the Stuart Lake Trail to around the Colchuck Lake junction, then leave it, cross Mountaineer Creek and bushwhack south toward Argonaut's north side, using talus to avoid the slide-alder slope. Snow usually starts near 4,700 ft. Climb the drainage to the couloir just east of the Northeast Buttress, follow it about 1,200 ft as it narrows, exit on a mid-fifth-class or icy pitch, and scramble to the A-frame summit blocks.
